description: BEP - visites des recyparcs is a group of related datasets listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by BEP. Nombre de visites dans les recyparcs The 4 datasets in this record: Nombre de visites dans les recyparcs; Visites sur les recyparcs du BEP en 2019; Visites sur les recyparcs du BEP en 2020; Visites sur les recyparcs du BEP en 2021. Coverage: Province of Namur (Wallonia). The portal lists 4 related datasets of one publisher (copies, years or sister lists), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Administration et Services publics, Agriculture, Environnement. Its keywords are Indicateurs, Environnement, Recyparcs. The portal shows 8 records. The portal shows 2026-07-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support waste collection, treatment and recycling network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
